name: test-batch
description: Resumable batch test runner. Collects pytest node-ids for a target, runs them in batches of N from a start index, and on the FIRST failing batch writes a report (with the exact relaunch command_args) + messages the requesting agent, then stops. Relaunch with the reported start index after fixing.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description: Start index into the collected node-id list (resume point). $1. Default 0.

arguments.name: batch
arguments.description: How many node-ids to run per batch. $2.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: pytest target to collect+run (path/dir/marker), e.g. tests/test_mcp_tools.py. $3.

arguments.name: notify
arguments.description: Agent name to message on stop (fail or all-passed), e.g. ux-audit. Also the state-file key. $4.

arguments.name: instance
arguments.description: Test instance name to run against (AXI_TEST_INSTANCE_NAME/DIR=~/axi-tests/<instance>), e.g. smoke-test. Must be UP. $5.

tb000002-setp-4000-8000-000000000002.name: SETUP: collect + init
tb000002-setp-4000-8000-000000000002.command:
D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"; N="$D/test-batch-$4-nodes.txt"; P="$D/test-batch-$4-pos.txt"; R="$D/test-batch-$4-report.txt"
uv run python -m pytest --collect-only -q "$3" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "::" > "$N" || true
echo "${1:-0}" > "$P"; : > "$R"
echo "collected $(wc -l < "$N" | tr -d ' ') test node-ids from '$3'; start=${1:-0} batch=$2 notify=$4 instance=$5"

tb000003-runb-4000-8000-000000000003.name: RUN BATCH
tb000003-runb-4000-8000-000000000003.command:
D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"; N="$D/test-batch-$4-nodes.txt"; P="$D/test-batch-$4-pos.txt"; R="$D/test-batch-$4-report.txt"
p=$(cat "$P"); total=$(wc -l < "$N" | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$p" -ge "$total" ]; then
  printf 'ALL PASSED: ran node-ids through %s of %s, no failures.\n' "$total" "$total" > "$R"
  printf 'stop'; exit 0
fi
end=$((p + $2)); [ "$end" -gt "$total" ] && end="$total"
batch=$(sed -n "$((p+1)),${end}p" "$N")
export AXI_TEST_INSTANCE_NAME="$5" AXI_TEST_INSTANCE_DIR="$HOME/axi-tests/$5"
out=$(uv run python -m pytest $batch -p no:cacheprovider -q --timeout=180 2>&1); rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  { printf 'FAILURE in batch at index %s (node-ids %s-%s of %s).\n\n' "$p" "$((p+1))" "$end" "$total"
    printf 'RELAUNCH after fixing:  command_args="%s %s %s %s %s"\n\n' "$p" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5"
    printf -- '--- batch node-ids ---\n%s\n\n--- pytest output (tail) ---\n' "$batch"
    printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -45; } > "$R"
  printf 'stop'; exit 0
fi
echo "$end" > "$P"; printf ''

tb000005-noti-4000-8000-000000000005.name: NOTIFY REQUESTER
tb000005-noti-4000-8000-000000000005.prompt:
[Automated flowchart step — not a user message.]

The batch runner has stopped (a failure, or all tests passed). Relay the report to the requesting agent:

1. Run:  cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/test-batch-$4-report.txt"
2. Send that exact content to the agent named "$4" via the axi_send_message tool (agent_name="$4", sender = your own agent name), prefixed with "[test-batch $3] ".
3. Do NOT run any tests yourself. You are done after sending.
